ns2:section.sectionText: Continuation of in-depth exploration, engagement, and development within the iSchool. Areas of focus will be directed by student interest and may include pathways, career paths, research, and leadership development. It is preferred students have already completed IS 100, but instructor approval may be provided if courses are taken concurrently. Always restricted to declared Information Sciences Majors. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to ischool-is@illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
